notablePrerequisites: The first three modes of Demonic Pact have been selected.
easyPrerequisites: An opponent must control an enchantment.
description:
Cast Shifting Grift for its third spree cost by paying {1}{U}{U}, exchanging control of an enchantment an opponent controls and Demonic Pact.
At the beginning of the opponent's upkeep, Demonic Pact triggers, causing them to select the fourth mode and lose the game.
